# awscc_lambda_web_function_revision (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Lambda::WebFunctionRevision. An immutable revision of a Lambda web function, containing the function code and configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_config` (Attributes) The build configuration for the revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build_config))
- `function_name` (String) The name of the web function this revision belongs to. The length constraint applies only to the full ARN. If you specify only the function name, it is limited to 64 characters in length.
- `service_config` (Attributes) The service configuration for the revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_config))

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the revision.
- `kms_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the revision.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the revision was created.
- `function_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the function.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `revision_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the revision.
- `revision_id` (String) The unique identifier of the revision.
- `state` (String) The current state of the revision.
- `state_reason` (String) The reason for the revision's current state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lambda_web_function_revision.example
  identity = {
    revision_arn = "revision_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `revision_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the revision

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lambda_web_function_revision.example
  id = "revision_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_lambda_web_function_revision.example "revision_arn"
```
